items.desc: AI生成された文章の不自然さを取り除き、人間にとって自然な日本語へ書き直すためのAgent Skill
Automatic project memory for Claude Code. Also works with Cursor and Codex. Now in Anthropic's Claude plugin directory.

⚡ Modular prompt-engineering framework for AI Agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot). Forces structured SDLC, linear execution, context isolation, and systematic debugging via a standalone Windows launcher. Stop vibe coding, start agentic discipline! 🚀
An open-source virtual AI Infra team that discovers, benchmarks, and safely upgrades local LLM inference—with independent quality gates, a stable OpenAI-compatible API, and automatic rollback.
A queryable second brain over your scattered notes and docs - hybrid retrieval (vector + BM25), section-level citations, and an MCP server so AI agents can use it. ~300 lines, no LangChain.
Persona agents with explicit memory, retrieval, adversarial smoke tests and a practical post-training roadmap.

A local app that rents a GPU in your own Colab account and serves Qwen3.8 on it: 27B on an A100-40G, or Flash-Next (125B-A6B MoE) on an A100-80G. The cost is shown before it starts; chat with images; Codex or any OpenAI client uses a fixed local /v1. Auto-stop, CU ledger, live prefill/decode. Windows, macOS, Linux.
Wiggle is a sandbox to run code in
LLM agent 的有界自纠错长期记忆层：把连续、含矛盾的项目交互日志蒸馏成有界、可自更新的记忆库。Bounded, self-correcting long-term memory for LLM agents — candidate pool + value dynamics + tension adjudication + causal-replay evals.
Local-first voice memory assistant — capture speech, transcribe live, and ask a private RAG chatbot grounded in what you've actually said. No cloud required.
Jev-style parallel constrained decisions for any MLX model on Apple Silicon. Typed, schema-valid JSON in one forward pass.
A nightly newspaper that writes itself: an agent runs the desks, the figures come from code, and it refuses to publish an edition with marks in it.
标书匠 BidCraft · 对话式标书编制系统：AI 智能编制技术标，支持招标文件解析、标段选择、标书编写、知识库提炼与学习对话式改稿。LLM-Wiki 路线，基于LangGraph实现。Open-source AI agent for construction tender & bid documents.
Benchmark local LLM serving by replaying real agent trajectories
Deterministic code-graph context engine for AI coding agents - PostgreSQL + Apache AGE + pgvector, MCP & REST, no LLM in the loop.
A Flutter client for herdr: a status board and live terminal for the coding agents on your own machines. Over SSH, with no bridge binary to install.
Hemmingway-1: a 27B model that writes the way a person writes. Open weights, free for non-commercial use (CC BY-NC 4.0); commercial use by agreement.
